title: Untitled (Gold Disc Collage)
description: Large-format collage constructed from layered paper sections forming an irregular garment-like silhouette. Gold compact discs border the perimeter and interior zones; motifs include a pink heart, soccer balls, a chess pawn, concentric targets, and red ribbon stripes across a fragmented field of orange, red, and black.
composition: irregular silhouette bordered by gold discs
